summary: Feed s097_single is degraded: IDS sees only one direction for 56.5% of TCP sessions (65/115), breaking stateful inspection. All other visibility checks (duplicates, drops, overload, encryption, VLAN) are healthy.

findings.root_cause: Packet broker/SPAN is delivering only one direction per TCP session to this IDS port. Most likely SPAN configured as RX-only/TX-only, TAP on a single link of an asymmetric path, or broker load-balancing without flow-aware aggregation so client->server and server->client go to different tool ports.
findings.impact_on_tool: IDS needs both directions for TCP handshake validation, stream reassembly and signature matching. With 56.5% one-way sessions the IDS will miss attacks, fail to detect bidirectional exploits, and generate incomplete session logs/false negatives.

recommended_fix.why: Ensure packet broker aggregates both directions of each flow to the same IDS tool port using 5-tuple bidirectional hashing, so the IDS receives complete sessions for stateful detection.
